responsibilities.name: Weekly Executive Update
responsibilities.instruction: Produce this week's Weekly Executive Update to structure the 30-minute weekly executive sync. Recall the weekly-executive-update process playbook, gather the most recent notes for each of this deployment's designated weekly source meetings, and synthesize a time-boxed executive briefing: an agenda-at-a-glance, a short State of the Week, per-area status with blockers flagged inline, the decisions to lock this week, and an owner/action/due table. Deliver it as a branded document in the exec-summaries folder and report the link.
responsibilities.success_criteria: A single dated Weekly Executive Update document exists in the exec-summaries folder, sourced ONLY from the most recent occurrence of each designated weekly source meeting. It is structured as a 30-minute agenda (agenda-at-a-glance, State of the Week, per-area status, Decisions to Lock, Blockers, and an Action Items table with owners and due dates), with acronyms and names normalized. The document link is reported.

context.purpose: Leadership runs a 30-minute weekly executive sync and needs one reliable, skimmable briefing, built the same way every week from that week's meeting notes.
process: RECALL: load the 'Weekly Executive Update' process playbook and this deployment's designated source meetings, exec-summaries folder, and branding reference from project context / memory.
GATHER: for each designated weekly source meeting, take only the MOST RECENT occurrence's notes or transcript (list the meeting folder and pick the latest by date; never fold in older weeks).

SYNTHESIZE: distill into the fixed 30-minute scaffold — agenda-at-a-glance, State of the Week, per-area status with inline blocker flags, Decisions to Lock, and an owner/action/due Action Items table. Normalize acronyms and names; produce one definitive briefing, not several drafts.
DELIVER: build the document with docs-create-branded into the exec-summaries folder using the standard exec-brief branding, then report the link.
